# Bekymrede investorer trækker - igen - globale aktiemarkeder ned

**Feed**: millionaerklubben  
**Published**: 2026-10-23  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Danish Millionærklubben episode (Oct 23, 2026) with guests Lars Svendsen (Svendsen & Tudborg) and Lars Persson (Aktierådet). The panel discusses a risk-off rotation out of AI/tech and electrification names (CoreWeave, Meta, ABB, Atlas Copco) into healthcare and consumer staples, with strong earnings and order books being ignored. A large part covers a spike in oil prices and possible manipulation of the WTI-Brent spread, an argument that money will leave a US market close to a crash, and listener questions on defence (Saab, Lockheed), tankers (Capital Tankers), hearing aids (GN/Demant), autos and tobacco.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 HLUN-B — Lundbeck | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Panelist's primary pick in healthcare, which has a tailwind.

#### Reasoning

The guest expects money to rotate from AI/tech into healthcare, which has underperformed for years. Lundbeck is his primary choice, with momentum building. This is guest opinion.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the healthcare rotation reverses
- if momentum fades

> *"Lundbæk er jo som min primære valg lige nu, hvor der er rygvind"*

---

### 🟢 AMBU-B — Ambu | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Panelist has been buying quality medtech including Ambu.

#### Reasoning

Part of the guest's high-quality medtech basket, bought for the healthcare rotation. Ambu is also cited as a stock where you add to a core position after a fall.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the healthcare rotation stalls

> *"jeg har jo købt et stykke tid også koloplast og embed og ambo"*

---

### 🟢 COLO-B — Coloplast | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Bought as part of the quality medtech basket.

#### Reasoning

The guest is accumulating quality medtech on the expectation that money rotates out of AI/US tech.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the sector rotation fails

> *"jeg har jo købt et stykke tid også koloplast"*

---

### 🟢 DRW3 — Drägerwerk | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Fell from 115 to 98 with no fundamental reason; panelist bought more yesterday.

#### Reasoning

The guest sees the fall as Mr. Market's mood rather than a fundamental problem, and is adding to the position.

#### Sell Triggers

- if a fundamental problem emerges

> *"Men der er ikke noget, der ser ud til, at der er noget dårligt hos dem."*

---

### 🟢 AFX — Carl Zeiss Meditec | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

German microsurgery/ophthalmology maker the panelist likes.

#### Reasoning

The guest likes it as part of his healthcare tilt.

> *"den anden tysker, jeg godt kan lide, der hedder Carl Zeiss"*

---

### 🟢 SAAB-B — Saab | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Strong report and huge order book; panelist just rebought it and says buy.

#### Reasoning

Defence demand is structural ('we need the hardware'). The guest just rebought it for clients, though he warns of double-digit report-day drops in Sweden this season.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the order book weakens
- if there are sharp falls this report season

> *"Jamen, vi skal bare bruge det der isenkram, beklageligvis, venner, men så køb den."*

---

### 🟢 LMT — Lockheed Martin | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Rose 7% on its report; buy signal in the panelist's technical system with RSI at 60.

#### Reasoning

Momentum has returned, with room for RSI to reach 70-80. The guest prefers European defence but suggests one US name or an ETF for diversification.

#### Sell Triggers

- if a momentum divergence appears
- if the RSI signal fails

> *"så meldte den sig ind i aktier med købsignaler i mit system"*

---

### ⛔ ABB — ABB | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 70%

Panelist sold and told clients to exit; downtrend despite a good report.

#### Reasoning

Clouds are gathering over electrification: local opposition to data centres, risk of cancelled orders and power-grid limits. Investors are taking profits after the run from 500 to 1100.

> *"Jeg har nemlig solgt den. Jeg sagde til mine kunder, at vi skulle ud af den"*

---

### ⛔ ATCO-A — Atlas Copco | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Weekly sell signal like ABB; panelist waits for the storm to pass.

#### Reasoning

Mining-equipment names have dropped despite strong order books. The guest wants the trend to turn before re-entering.

#### Sell Triggers

- re-enter if the trend turns positive

> *"Så jeg tror lige, at jeg lader stormen ride af og tingene vende"*

---

### 🟠 WRT1V — Wärtsilä | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Panelist is warmer on it; island power generators and a big order near Venezuela.

#### Reasoning

Backup generation for islands when there is no sun or wind is an attractive angle within the electrification theme.

> *"Men jeg er lidt mere lun på Vachilla, faktisk, oppe i Finland."*

---

### 🟡 FRO — Frontline | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Sold the top-up shares but still holds more Frontline than Capital Tankers.

#### Reasoning

Tanker rates benefit from longer oil trade routes. The guest trimmed but is still overweight.

#### Sell Triggers

- if tanker rates fall

> *"Jeg har jo stadigvæk flere frontdreng, end jeg har af ham."*

---

### 🟠 PNDORA — Pandora | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Range-bound 800-840 with no momentum; on the candidate bench but waiting for a breakout.

#### Reasoning

The panelist waits for momentum and is willing to buy a few percent higher once an uptrend is confirmed.

#### Sell Triggers

- buy only on a breakout above 840

> *"men jeg vil vente i hvert fald. Men det er en af dem, der sidder på kandidatbænken"*

---

### 🟠 SUBC — Subsea 7 | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Panelist believes more in subsea contractors than in drillers.

#### Reasoning

Subsea contractors are preferred within oil service, though the guest fears oil prices fall once the Russia situation ends.

#### Sell Triggers

- if oil prices fall after a Russia resolution

> *"Og det der, det tror jeg mere på end på de andre."*

---

### 🟢 GN — GN Store Nord | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Technical target 160; 12bn from the Amplifon deal versus 8bn debt; takeover speculation.

#### Reasoning

Market cap ~16bn against net cash after the deal plus Amplifon shares. The guest believes this is GN's last year in its current form. Awaiting regulatory approval.

#### Sell Triggers

- if regulators block the Amplifon deal

> *"160 er mit mål."*

---

### ⛔ VOLCAR-B — Volvo Cars | **AVOID** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Down 30%; panelist expects further falls and avoids the carmakers.

#### Reasoning

European carmakers are hit by Chinese competition and tariffs. The guest prefers suppliers such as safety systems.

> *"Åh nej tak, jeg tror den falder"*

---

### 🟢 STG — Scandinavian Tobacco Group | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Bought at 68, now 78; still a cheap discount stock; possible Cuba cigar upside.

#### Reasoning

Low valuation, and the brand sale to Japan Tobacco shows asset value. Possible access to Cuban premium tobacco if the regime falls.

#### Sell Triggers

- if regulation on smoking tightens

> *"Men det er jo stadigvæk sådan noget discount. Det er jo meget lavt prissat aktie."*

---
